_note: Items not machine-extracted from the statements. All from Theon's own regulated releases / reports (media.theon.com, theon.com news). The user accepted regulator-filed documents in lieu of EDGAR (Theon is not an SEC registrant); forward-looking guidance from these documents is labelled 'unverified (not EDGAR)'. EUR millions unless stated.

kpi_ytd._note: Order intake (year-to-date, as printed in each release) and soft backlog / options at period end (company definition: remaining contract value of existing and anticipated contracts). Discrete quarters are derived as YTD differences in normalize.py.

shares._note: Weighted average ordinary shares (basic = diluted), millions, from the EPS notes. restatements.2022: AR2023 note 37: correction of errors; FY2022 revenue 147.386 → 142.895, operating profit 40.997 → 40.232, net income 30.597 → 30.004; BS 31-Dec-2022 and 1-Jan-2022 restated (staff indemnity reclass, ROU split, prepayments). The model uses the restated figures for FY2022 and the 31-Dec-2021 balance sheet; FY2021 P&L stays as first reported (no restated 2021 P&L was published).
restatements.2024_policy: AR2025 note 7.a / H1-25 report: from Q2-2025 (effective 1-Jan-2025) the share of profit of core equity-accounted investees is presented within operating profit and adjusted EBIT/EBITDA. 2024 comparatives restated (FY2024 operating profit 86.852 → 89.299; adjusted EBIT 88.386 → 90.833). Q1-2025 restated in the Q1-2026 update (adjusted EBIT 23.018 → 23.777; adjusted EBITDA 23.952 → 24.711). The model presents the share of profit as its own line inside operating profit in every period (current definition) and checks adjusted EBIT against each period's published figure on the definition then in force.

h1_26_tu_vs_report: Q2/H1-2026 trading update (27-Jul-2026) printed H1-26 adjusted EBITDA 69.0 and adjusted EBIT 65.1; the H1 2026 report (7-Sep-2026) shows adjusted EBITDA 69.956 and adjusted EBIT 65.139. The report wins.
